controls.issue: Generated user asks for 'punktine sarasa' with incorrect agreement/case (actual accented text retained in candidate); assistant facts otherwise follow the supplied dates.

User says 'za otoka' instead of 'za otroka'; answer uses 'z podzemno' rather than 's podzemno' and adds unsupported 'zgodnji' to the Kremlin description.

limitations: Small purposive sample; not an estimated corpus-wide error rate.
